headline: The firefly got out
lede: Boulder Dash's firefly now flies with momentum — bounce down a heading until a corridor opens, and it takes it. Dig the shaft under FLY PIT and the bomb in the box finally detonates the dust chain across the cave.

notes.text: #2364 shipped (PR #2373): CFG.flyTravel gives the fly a held heading with steel-only turns; FLY PIT gained a bored dust-seam door and a roof corridor. dashcheck grew to 54 checks (+7) and every one of 7 mutants dies by name, incl. the new flyTravel one.

Two prod-verify traps fixed in the notes: jalfern.com 308-redirects to www (bare curl sees no assets), and a marker must be a string the PR introduced — the pit itself predated the change and grepped green for ten false minutes.
The merge sat on the #2370 red-main freeze until its nightly cleared; rule-5 loop then shipped it clean. QA polish pass filed as #2374.

look.text: Boulder Dash — dig under FLY PIT and let it out
